learnings.title: Fed/CFPB: 2027 Regulation Z and M consumer credit/lease threshold is $76,300
learnings.claim: Federal Reserve joint press release bcreg20261125b (Nov 25, 2026; feed pubDate Wed, 25 Nov 2026 20:00:00 GMT; page read 2026-11-28) states the Fed Board and CFPB announced 2027 dollar thresholds: based on the 3.9 percent CPI-W increase as of June 1, 2026, Regulation Z (Truth in Lending) and Regulation M (Consumer Leasing) generally apply to consumer credit transactions and consumer leases of $76,300 or less in 2027. Private education loans and loans secured by real property (e.g. mortgages) are subject to Regulation Z regardless of amount. Companion release bcreg20261125a: 2027 higher-priced mortgage appraisal exemption threshold rises from $34,200 to $35,500, effective January 1, 2027.
learnings.decision: REVIEW_ONLY: finance plan notes the 2027 Reg Z/M $76,300 threshold as regulatory context; no operational action or automated change.
learnings.next_measurement: Before 2027-01-01 record yes/no whether any owned product or flow involves consumer credit/leases near the threshold.
